_comment: Permanent security-guard accounts. Created ONCE by scripts/seed-guard-accounts.mjs
and NEVER deleted. See the standing rule in CLAUDE.md: deleting an auth.users row
strands canonical_history rows that no RLS policy can ever reach, because the
predicate is user_id = auth.uid() and no such user can authenticate.
These are throwaway credentials for RLS-isolated accounts on the reserved .invalid
TLD. They hold only marked test rows, public signups are disabled, and every table
they touch is per-user isolated (that is precisely what the guards prove). Committing
them matches the pre-existing practice these scripts already used.
Read via readFileSync + JSON.parse so both the .mjs and .ts guards share one source
of truth with no module-resolution or typecheck risk.
